title: About Jenna Rhae White | Freedom Life Coach
metaDescription: I’m Jenna Rhae, and I want to help you step into the freedom Jesus Christ has for you. It’s time to heal and grow with Christ-centered trauma coaching.

sections.text: Hi friend — I’m so glad you’re here.

If we were meeting in person, this would probably look like a cozy coffee shop conversation filled with honesty, laughter, depth, and encouragement. Connection and people’s stories have always mattered deeply to me, and I consider it an incredible privilege to walk alongside others in seasons of healing, growth, and transformation.

I’m Jenna White. Many people have previously known me professionally as Jenna Barbosa, and as I’ve stepped into this new season of marriage and family, I’m also stepping into a rebrand under the name Jennarhae — a name created from my first and middle name that feels deeply personal to who I am and the heart behind my work.

I recently married the love of my life, Joshua, and in one beautiful season of change, relocated from St. Louis to the Kansas City area while becoming a bonus mom to four amazing stepchildren, ages 15–23. Life looks a little different these days, and honestly, it’s fuller and sweeter than I could have imagined.

I’m a Certified Christian Life Coach and Biblical Counselor passionate about helping people move from survival mode into emotional, spiritual, and relational health. My approach blends practical psychology, biblical truth, nervous system healing, and compassionate coaching to help people find freedom from anxiety, trauma patterns, shame, emotional overwhelm, and feeling stuck.

Whether I’m coaching one-on-one, teaching from a stage, leading workshops, or creating resources online, my heart is the same: helping people build resilient, healthy lives rooted in truth, purpose, and connection with God.

items: Coffee is absolutely my love language.
The beach will forever be my happy place.
I love travel, deep conversations, pottery, and creating spaces where people feel safe to be fully seen and known.

sections.text: I’m truly honored you’re here, and I look forward to connecting with you.
